input.title: BH | Premier Holkham Embossed Leather Tray
input.descriptionHtml:
After a winter walk on Holkham beach, one of the widest stretches of sand on the Norfolk coast, the reward is coming back to the house and carrying the drinks through on a tray. This tray is made for that homecoming. It is large enough at 24 by 18 inches for a teapot and four cups, or a bottle and a few glasses, and its raised sides keep everything steady as you carry it from the kitchen to the fire.

It is covered in leather embossed with a crocodile pattern, over a wood base, and finished with brass and steel, so it has the polish of an old travelling case. At 8 lbs it feels sturdy without being heavy to carry, even when loaded. It arrives ready to use.

Use it on an ottoman or a coffee table to gather candles, the remote and a stack of books, or on a sideboard as a small home bar with a decanter, an ice bucket and glasses. This listing is for one tray.

input.title: BH | Premier Saint-Junien Leather Boxes, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
Saint-Junien, in the Limousin, has been France's glove-making town for centuries, and its craft is all about the small, well-made leather thing you handle every day. These boxes are made for that daily handling: a place to drop the rings you take off at night, the cufflinks, the spare keys and the stamps. Wrapped in leather, they are soft to the touch, quiet on a polished surface and handsome enough to leave out on show.

Each box is leather embossed with a crocodile grain, wrapped over a sturdy wood core. They are small enough to sit on a crowded dresser and big enough to keep a day's small things together. Their wood cores give them a firm, squared shape that sits neatly on a shelf, and they arrive ready to use.

Keep one on a dresser or bedside table for jewellery and watches, and the other on a desk for paper clips, stamps and a fountain pen, or stack them on a hall table beside the keys. This set includes two leather boxes.

input.title: BH | Premier Ludwigsburg Embossed Leather Box — In Claret
input.descriptionHtml:
In a house in Ludwigsburg, a short walk from its baroque palace, the small things that matter are kept together in one place: the letters, the cards, the watch put away for Sundays. This leather box is made for that kind of keeping: lifting a lid to find exactly what you put away. Its hinged lid lifts easily, and inside there is room for letters, jewellery, remotes or a deck of cards, all safe and out of sight.

It is wood wrapped all over in embossed leather, pressed with a pattern that catches the light, and finished with brass accents in an aged tone. At 11 lbs it is easy to lift from a shelf and carry to the sofa. Lined up on a shelf or set alone on a table, it reads as something kept and treasured rather than simply stored. It arrives ready to use.

Set it on a coffee table to hold remotes and coasters, on a dresser for watches and cufflinks, or on a library shelf as a home for letters and photographs. This listing is for one leather box.

input.title: BH | Premier Lausanne Velvet Side Chair — In Alabaster with Cream Upholstery
input.descriptionHtml:
In a Lausanne apartment above Lake Geneva, dinner is a long and civilized affair, with the lights of the French shore coming on across the water as the courses come and go. This side chair is made to keep you comfortable through every one of them. Its back is shaped to follow and support you, and its soft upholstery invites you to stay put long after the plates are cleared.

The frame is beechwood in a painted finish, and it is upholstered in a performance velvet, a hard-wearing polyester with a soft pile made for everyday use. At 18 lbs it is easy to draw in and out from the table, and its slim 18-inch width lets several sit side by side without crowding. It arrives fully assembled.

Place a set along both sides of a long table with candles and a linen runner, or use one at a desk in a study, where its supportive back earns its keep. This listing is for one side chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Bantry Linen Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Almond with Greige Upholstery
input.descriptionHtml:
Bantry House looks out over Bantry Bay in West Cork, and dinner in a house on that bay means family and friends around one long table, with the light lingering late over the water. These side chairs are made for those long dinners. Their curved backs are good to lean into between courses, and their linen covers keep the look relaxed and coastal while the evening runs on and the plates keep coming.

Each chair is built on a solid oak frame and covered in linen, with a seat 20 inches high and 17 deep that suits a standard dining table. The oak frame gives them a firm, steady seat, and they are as at home drawn up to a desk as at the dining table. They arrive fully assembled.

Set the pair at a dining table with candles and a big dish of mussels in the middle, or use them as extra seats at a desk or by a bedroom window. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Locarno Curved-Back Upholstered Side Chair
input.descriptionHtml:
Every August, Locarno's Piazza Grande becomes an open-air cinema, and the evening has a happy routine: dinner nearby, then thousands of chairs facing one huge screen as the film starts under the stars. This chair is made for that kind of evening at home, when the film goes on and everyone pulls up a seat. Its curving back holds you comfortably through a long feature, and its upholstered seat stays soft from the opening titles to the final scene.

It is made on a beechwood frame, a strong, close-grained hardwood, with a seat and back upholstered in fabric. Its graceful curves give it a light, sculptural look from every side, so it looks as good pulled into a circle of seats as it does standing alone in a corner. At 24 inches wide it fits easily into a small room. It arrives fully assembled.

Set one in a bedroom corner with a throw over the back, or bring a pair into the living room for movie nights, beside a side table holding a bowl of popcorn and two glasses. This listing is for one side chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Torcello Small Embossed Leather Sideboard — In Alabaster with Pewter Base
input.descriptionHtml:
Dinner on Torcello is served in no hurry, course by course, with the lagoon quiet all around and the island's old campanile standing over the tables. This smaller sideboard is made for serving at a table for four. It keeps the next course, the wine and the coffee cups within reach, and at about four feet wide it fits a breakfast room or the end of a kitchen where a longer one would not.

The whole case is wrapped in embossed leather, its door panels lifted slightly and worked with a diamond pattern from edge to edge, and behind them the interior is left in plain natural wood. It stands on an iron base with a stainless finish, with stainless steel handles to match, and at 34 inches high its top is a comfortable height for pouring or setting down the dessert. It arrives fully assembled.

Place it in a small dining room, a breakfast nook or a hall, with a lamp, a carafe and glasses on top, and napkins, placemats and candles behind the doors. This listing is for one small sideboard.

input.title: BH | Premier Sea Ranch Leather Dining Chairs, Set of 2 — In Alabaster with Greige Upholstery
input.descriptionHtml:
The Sea Ranch, on the Sonoma coast, was planned in the 1960s around plain timber houses, open views and meals shared at a big table facing the ocean. These dining chairs are made for that clean, easy way of living. Their open cut-out backs keep a table looking light even when every chair is pulled up, and their smooth leather upholstery stays comfortable through a long supper.

They are upholstered in aniline leather, dyed through and left uncoated so the natural grain shows and softens with age, with fabric alongside, over a wood frame with a washed finish. At 18 inches wide they fit closely around a table, so a few more friends can join, and the open back gives a hand somewhere to grip when drawing a chair in or out. They arrive fully assembled.

Arrange them around a long wooden dining table with a linen runner, a bowl of sea glass and a platter of grilled fish, or set the pair at a round kitchen table by a window. This set includes two dining chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Zermatt Leather Swivel Chair
input.descriptionHtml:
In a Zermatt chalet the Matterhorn is the view everyone wants, and the best chair in the room is the one that can turn toward it. This swivel chair is made for following the view. It turns from the conversation to the window and back without your leaving the seat, and its low slipper shape and soft top grain leather make it an easy place to sink into after a day outside.

It is covered in top grain leather, which grows softer with use, and it swivels smoothly on its base. Its compact form lets a pair sit close together without crowding a room, and at 33 inches high it keeps a low profile in front of a window. It needs some assembly.

Set a pair by a big window with a small table between them for coffee or a glass of wine, or put one in a bedroom corner with a lamp, a throw and the novel you are halfway through. This listing is for one swivel chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Begur Tufted Leather Bench — In Cream with Pewter Base
input.descriptionHtml:
In Begur's airy old Indiano houses, high above the coves of the Catalan coast, a small seat by the door is where you sit to buckle sandals before heading down to the water. This bench is made for that moment. Its tufted leather seat is soft and well padded, and its slim steel frame keeps it light to the eye, so it fits a narrow hall without crowding it.

The seat is leather, tufted over foam on an MDF base, and it rests on a frame of stainless steel straps, narrow bands of steel that run down to the floor and resist rust. At 27 inches wide and 18 high it sits at an easy height, and at 46 lbs it is steady underfoot. It arrives fully assembled.

It is at home at the foot of a bed with a folded throw across it, in an entry beside a row of shoes, or tucked under a dressing table as the seat for putting on earrings and taking a last look in the mirror. This listing is for one bench.

input.descriptionHtml:
Summer lunches in Atrani start with the plates. Before anyone sits down, the table along the terrace is set from the long cabinet against the wall: stacks of white dishes, a basket of bread, jugs of water and wine, the good linen kept for when the whole family comes around the headland from Amalfi. This sideboard is made to keep all of that in one place. Its long run of doors hides the china for a whole dining room, and its top is long enough to serve from.

It is built from pine, with six plain wood doors across its front over fixed shelves, and the unbroken run of panels reads as calm and orderly the whole length of the room. At 15 inches deep it keeps close to the wall, and at more than nine feet long it gives a big table the storage to match. It arrives fully assembled.

Give it the longest dining room wall, with a pair of tall lamps, a row of serving bowls and a bottle or two ready for the table, or use it in a long hall to hold candles, napkins and the extra glasses. This listing is for one sideboard.

input.title: BH | Premier Senlis Channel-Tufted Leather Sofa — In Cream with Cocoa Base
input.descriptionHtml:
Senlis, north of Paris, is a medieval town of cobbled lanes gathered around its early Gothic cathedral, and when the day is done its stone houses draw in for a long evening at home. This sofa is made for that drawing in. Its back is stitched into long upright channels, which give firm, even support all the way along, and its seat foam is denser than most, so the cushion keeps its shape night after night.

Its covering is top grain leather that softens with use, and it is raised on rubberwood legs, a dense hardwood, set on a shaped wooden base that keeps the whole sofa low and grounded. At 85 inches long there is room to stretch out. It needs light assembly on arrival.

At 40 inches deep there is space for shared dishes down the centre and a place laid for everyone along both sides. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Put it in a long dining room or an open kitchen under a row of pendant lights, with a bowl of lemons, bottles of olive oil and wine, and bread on a board in the middle for everyone to tear. This listing is for one dining table.

Place it by a fire or a big window in a living room with a lamp and a wool throw, or set two facing a sofa across a low table. This listing is for one armchair.
